Reservations must be made in advance and payment is required at the time of reservation Tours begin with a five minute guided walk down our boardwalk leading to our new Shell Trailhead Circle. blurb: Armand Bayou Nature Center offers interactive outdoor education classes for kids aged 18 months to 18 years, including EcoTots, EcoKids, EcoSchoolers, EcoAdventurers, and EcoTeens. They provide outdoor camps during school breaks and specialized programs for Scouts to earn badges and explore nature. The center also supports educators with TEKS-aligned programs and professional development opportunities.
